exposure: type of recurrent pregnancy loss (primary vs. secondary)
cohort: The study included 295 women (157 with primary RPL and 138 with secondary RPL) undergoing a complete work-up and personalized therapeutic management.
finding: After comprehensive work-up and personalized management, a higher live birth rate was observed in women with primary RPL compared to secondary RPL (76% vs. 56%), with age <40 years and AMH >1 ng/mL identified as significant positive predictors for live birth.
